background: A going-into-the-cheta farewell. A young man tells his girl to mourn him while he goes over Pirin mountain to the committee's gathering places. Go to the garden, pick a bouquet of roses and adorn the voivoda Delčev and his faithful band.
background_source: Source of these notes: Qwen's draft.
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Оти' is rendered 'for' and 'накити Делчев војвода' is rendered as adorning Voivode Delchev and his band (with the roses), my reading. The refrain 'Малино моме' is kept in every line.

lines.cyr: Ајде жалај ме, Малино моме, плакај ме,
lines.lat: Ajde žalaj me, Malino mome, plakaj me,
lines.en: Come on, mourn me, Malina girl, weep for me,

lines.cyr: оти јас ќе одам, Малино моме, комита.
lines.lat: oti jas ḱe odam, Malino mome, komita.
lines.en: for I am going off as a guerrilla.

lines.cyr: Ај на таа Пирин, Малино моме, планина,
lines.lat: Aj na taa Pirin, Malino mome, planina,
lines.en: Up on that Pirin, Malina girl, mountain,
to the guerrillas', Malina girl, gathering places.

lines.cyr: Ајде ја отиди, Малино моме, в' градина,
lines.lat: Ajde ja otidi, Malino mome, v' gradina,
lines.en: Come on, go into the garden, Malina girl,

lines.cyr: ајде па набери, Малино моме, трендафил.
lines.lat: ajde pa naberi, Malino mome, trendafil.
lines.en: come on, then pick, Malina girl, a rose.

lines.cyr: Ајде па накити, Малиној моме, Делчев војвода
lines.lat: Ajde pa nakiti, Malinoj mome, Delčev vojvoda
lines.en: Come on, then adorn, Malina girl, Voivode Delchev

lines.cyr: а и негова, Малино моме, дружина.
lines.lat: a i negova, Malino mome, družina.
